originalTitle: Little relief expected for gas prices ahead of Election Day, according to prediction markets
summary: Gas prices are expected to remain above $4 per gallon on Nov. 3, according to traders on prediction market platform Kalshi.
content:
Affordability is seen as one of voters' top issues heading into the 2026 midterm elections . And gas prices — one of the items where consumers are getting squeezed the most — are expected to remain elevated through Election Day.

Speculators on prediction market platform Kalshi give an 87% chance that the AAA national average for gas prices will remain above $4 per gallon on Nov. 3.

But while they expect prices to stay above that mark, they do think there's a chance they'll come down from the levels where they currently are, giving just a 42% chance the average is above $4.25 on Election Day. As of Thursday, the national average is currently at $4.36 per gallon.

Gas prices peaked at an average of $4.56 per gallon in late May, following an initial spike in March after the start of the Iran war and the latter country's closure of the Strait of Hormuz , a critical passageway for oil exports from the Middle East. They then fell to as low as $3.79 per gallon in early July before rising again throughout the rest of the summer.

Diesel prices hit new peaks in September, though, reaching almost $6.53 per gallon on Sept. 22. Prices have since fallen to $6.28, though traders on Kalshi place 68% odds that figure remains above $6 per gallon on Nov. 3.

Rising diesel prices have a particular impact in states with larger agriculture industries , such as Iowa and Kansas, and states such as Alaska that rely on diesel fuel for electricity. All three are home to competitive races for the U.S. Senate this November.

As gas prices have remained elevated, Democrats' chances for flipping the Senate have improved . Traders on Kalshi give the party 63% odds of taking the upper chamber from Republican control.

Disclosure: CNBC and Kalshi have a commercial relationship that includes customer acquisition and a minority investment.
chineseTitle: 市场预测称，选举日之前天然气价格预计不会有任何缓解
chineseSummary: 据预测市场平台 Kalshi 的交易员称，预计 11 月 3 日天然气价格将保持在每加仑 4 美元以上。
chineseContent:
在 2026 年中期选举之前，负担能力被视为选民最关心的问题之一。天然气价格——消费者受到挤压最严重的项目之一——预计在选举日期间将保持高位。

预测市场平台 Kalshi 上的投机者认为 11 月 3 日 AAA 全国平均天然气价格将保持在每加仑 4 美元以上的可能性为 87%。

不过，尽管他们预计价格将保持在这一水平之上，但他们确实认为价格有可能从目前的水平回落，因此选举日平均价格高于 4.25 美元的可能性只有 42%。截至周四，全国平均价格为每加仑 4.36 美元。

伊朗战争爆发以及伊朗关闭霍尔木兹海峡（中东石油出口的重要通道）后，天然气价格在 3 月份首次飙升，并于 5 月底达到平均每加仑 4.56 美元的峰值。然后，价格在 7 月初跌至每加仑 3.79 美元，然后在夏季剩余时间再次上涨。

不过，柴油价格在 9 月份创下新高，在 9 月 22 日达到每加仑近 6.53 美元。此后价格已跌至 6.28 美元，尽管 Kalshi 的贸易商认为 11 月 3 日这一数字仍高于每加仑 6 美元的可能性为 68%。

柴油价格上涨对爱荷华州和堪萨斯州等农业规模较大的州以及阿拉斯加州等依赖柴油发电的州影响尤为明显。这三个地方都是今年 11 月美国参议院竞争激烈的地方。

由于天然气价格居高不下，民主党推翻参议院的机会有所增加。卡尔希的交易员认为该党有 63% 的可能性从共和党手中夺取上议院。

披露：CNBC 和 Kalshi 之间存在商业关系，包括客户获取和少数股权投资。
whyItMatters: 这条信息属于财经市场信号，适合用于观察利率、汇率、股债商品、金融机构和宏观政策变化。
